method.standard_error: Sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(n)
method.interval: Mean plus or minus t(1 - alpha / 2, n - 1) times the standard error
method.assumptions: Independent participants under the sampling model. The Student t interval is exact for normal observations and is used here as a large-sample approximation for the means.
method.value_rules: Reuse the Phase 1 usability rules and sample flags. Retain measurements outside IQR review fences.
method.coverage_interpretation: Under repeated sampling with the stated assumptions, a nominal 95% procedure covers the target population parameter in about 95% of repeated samples.
method.generalization: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.

mean_score.parameter: Population mean ANIMALS score under the paired_normal eligibility rules

mean_thickness.parameter: Population mean left inferior parietal cortical thickness under the paired_normal rules
